storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
The artist from Cité cares not for other people. She only pursues the absolute form of pure beauty, etching ephemeral moments into eternity.

As her inspiration surges forth, her chisel never ceases; as her works witness completion, her body is submerged in coral-colored shades. In the corner of her workshop which she pays no heed, her agony and delight intertwine, sprouting from her very existence.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
"In the year of A.F.3@2, the Marine Ecology Team of Mythag University discovered an oddly shaped coral reef while conducting species observations in the southern seas...

"Have found peculiar fragments; probably consist of elements wholly unspotted on Earth. Flexibility preserved in water, but hardened quickly after exposed to air. The joint research conducted by the Biology and Astronomy departments suggests that it is highly likely to be classified as unknown extraterrestrial material..."

"Awakened at A.F.3@1, awaken code-name Sanga.

The sculpting behaviour has been performed since awakening. The resulting art style, known for its bizarre surfaces and grotesque lines, is difficult to attribute to any specific genre. Though constantly unsettling its viewers, those works stay far from helping the dissolution research."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"At the day of @1 @1, the university cemetery was vandalized again. This marks the third grave-robbing incident this month.

After weeks of investigation, the Awakener Sanga has been preliminarily identified as the suspect by the association.

No doubt anyone visiting her workshop would be shocked by those various grotesque and blasphemous ocean-themed sculptures before questioning their material sources: the shell necklace Natasha wore for her burial; Aberdeen granite that shared similarities with tombstones. Unlike Pickman, who loves explaining his artistic concepts, Sanga is more elusive—our all queries resulting in nothing more than a smile.

Don't touch her chisel, and don't stay alone with her in her workshop—Professor Dexter warned us. However, radical measures are necessary to uncover the truth behind the grave robberies.

It's 00:45 on @1 @1. Member @2 of the Detective Enthusiast Association has sneaked into Sanga's workshop. Wish me good @3"

—Excerpt from "Detective Enthusiast Association, Investigation Record S-618"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Cité Art Salon Exhibition, A.F.2@1.

"Let me take her home!" The assailant shouted while hammering at the sculptor August's final work, "The Nameless Ms. Coral," before hastily stopped by the congregation. However, this unstrung old man had surprisingly turned out to be none other than the long-reclusive August himself.

For a time, speculations and discussions about "The Nameless Ms. Coral" flooded in.

Some people said it was inspired by a female apprentice named Sanga, who was the actual owner of August's best works. August is merely a shameful plagiarist.

Some people said that Sanga came from an illustrious family—her father was a renowned writer, and her brother was a diplomat. In order to pursue the sculpture art, she disengaged with her family and set alone to Paris, living penuriously until her death.

Some people said Sanga suffered from a strange illness. Ominous black ooze streamed on her body, and her each carving transformed a part of her flesh into coral. "The Nameless Ms. Coral" was actually her coraled appearance, not a sculpture at all.

Other people said...

The apprentice, the devoted, the patient. Words pile upon Ms. Coral, sculpting her as the crowd dispersed from the exhibition hall. She blinks in the pouring moonlight. She's still waiting, and waiting—for her moment of returning home.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Watched by countless nights, the sculptor suffered from Dissolution slips beneath the murmuring waves, falling into writhing dreams:
As Lemuria's spirals inflamed by her kindreds, its majestic walls arise in her hands.

As the Father and His servants slumbering into epics, their statues find immortality under her carving.

Her senses dull. Her body stiffens. Her chisel nearly escapes.

Coral-like white mists have crept to her forearms. Hands tremble under her gaze. A smile flickers. Her life will fade like an extinguishing candle, while her body will step beyond eternal's door.

Her wish fullfilled as she sinking onto the seabed. Coral shattering to foam, black slime of Dissolution threads into the ocean—she finally embraces the City long-lost in currents, and mingles with its splendor—together, ever after.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Sanga, the sculptor from Cité, offers you her chisel. You may be flawed, but you are still worth carving.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: You chose the perfect carving knife for me.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Good taste.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Inspirations are endlessly flowing...

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Absolutely amazing... Your offhand remark has resolved a creative problem that has been troubling me for months.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I am well acquainted with the pain of carving and the burning of transformation. Yet all of this fades when compared to eternal beauty.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: I need only a bit of stone, two chisels, and three sun-facing irises... and I can create anything for you.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: I shall convey these unspoken words to you through my work.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Thank you for preparing this studio for me. Everything here is bathed in sunlight; it seems that every piece of work, every carving knife, glows with a golden light. Oh, spring is golden.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: The sleeping sovereign murmurs in my ear, the ruins of the deep sea constantly reconstruct before my eyes... Have the countless dream scenes finally come true?

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: A wonderful life lies in indulgence. Sometimes, you shouldn't be too hard on yourself.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Inspiration is like bubbles rising in the sea: a gentle touch, and they vanish. Are you the same?

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: War, plunder, and fame are all human desires. The humble sculptor has no interest in what humans pursue; she only wishes to be a slave to beauty.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Smiles and etiquette serve as a layer of armor, helping me maintain distance from others and avoid tedious disturbances. As for my true self... I don't mind showing it to you.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: My thoughts accumulate like white limestone and are washed into beautiful coral. They merge with me, pulsing with my heartbeat... Will you listen?

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Ugh! Your temperature is a bit high for coral. But... it's warm and intense. I like it.

daily.title: Chat: About Past
daily.content: I'm from Cité. There, everyone wants to be an actor; no one is content with just watching. In reality, we are merely the city's pitiful footnotes.

daily.title: Chat: About Aurita
daily.content: Pickman and I are working on some fascinating installation art, exploring the reconstruction of abstract representationism by deconstructing visual primitivism... Huh, why did Aurita faint?

daily.title: Chat: About Morning
daily.content: The air on campus at 4 AM is refreshing. I'm glad you're willing to work out with me. I must say, sculpting is quite the workout.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: From Dissolution wounds flows not only black slime but also endless inspiration. Honestly, I wouldn't mind some more.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Did you know about the legend of that certain "Painter" here? From those expressionist graffiti, I sense a familiar touch...

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I enjoy wandering aimlessly. Swamps, graveyards, infirmaries, abandoned castles... In these places, I always find unexpected delights.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Things I hate...? None. Would you hate a speck of dust or a leaf?

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Explaining art is as ridiculous as explaining railroad stocks—please don't make life harder for us artists.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: I need to gather some carving materials, preferably fresh ones.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: What a glorious victory... I shall engrave this moment into eternity.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Sometimes, the beauty of art lies in its annihilation. But your failure... clearly doesn't fall into that category.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: The long-lost city of Lemuria, now finally unveiled.
